title: Unit 1 Good habits 单元测试卷

wrong.stem: 听录音，选出你听到的单词。
wrong.exp: 录音读的是 healthy（健康的）。health 是“健康”（名词），heavy 是“重的”。

wrong.stem: 听录音，选出你听到的单词。
wrong.exp: 录音读的是 late（迟，晚）。wait 是“等”，eight 是“八”。

wrong.stem: 听录音，选择正确的答语。
options: Because it is bad for my eyes.
wrong.exp: 问句是 What good habits do you have?（你有什么好习惯？）要用好习惯的内容来回答，不能用 Yes 开头。

wrong.stem: 听录音，选择正确的答语。
options: Yes. I often read in bed.
I listen to my teachers carefully.
wrong.mine: I listen to my teachers carefully.
wrong.right: Yes. I often read in bed.
wrong.exp: 问句是 Do you have any bad habits?（你有坏习惯吗？）先答 Yes，再说出坏习惯：often read in bed（经常在床上读书）。

wrong.stem: 听录音，选择正确的答语。
options: Because it is bad for her eyes.
wrong.right: Because it is bad for her eyes.
wrong.exp: Why 问原因，要用 Because 回答：Because it is bad for her eyes.（因为对她的眼睛不好。）

wrong.stem: 听录音，判断对错。Wang Bing puts his school things in order every morning.
wrong.exp: 录音说的是 every evening（每天晚上），不是 morning（早上），所以是错的。

wrong.stem: 听录音，判断对错。Wang Bing often goes to bed late.
wrong.exp: 录音说 But he often goes to bed late.（但他经常晚睡），所以是对的。注意：主语是 he，go 要变 goes。

wrong.stem: 听录音，看中文，拼出单词：整齐的
wrong.exp: 录音读的是 tidy（整齐的）。课文：Bobby never keeps his room tidy.

wrong.stem: 听录音，看中文，拼出单词：从不
wrong.exp: 录音读的是 never（从不）。

wrong.stem: 听录音，看中文，拼出单词：健康的
wrong.exp: 录音读的是 healthy（健康的）。课文：He is strong and healthy.

wrong.stem: 选出划线部分发音不同的一项。
wrong.exp: blue、black、blackboard 的 bl 都读 /bl/（本单元 Sound time）；class 的 cl 读 /kl/，不同。课文句：I like your blue desk.

wrong.stem: 选出划线部分发音不同的一项。
wrong.exp: blue、black、blackboard 的 bl 都读 /bl/；brown 的 br 读 /br/，不同。

wrong.stem: 选出划线部分发音不同的一项。
wrong.exp: black、blue、blackboard 的 bl 都读 /bl/；brown 的 br 读 /br/，不同。课文句：The girl looks at the blackboard.

wrong.stem: 选出不同类的一项。
wrong.exp: tidy、clean、healthy 都是形容词（整齐的、干净的、健康的）；habit 是名词（习惯），不同类。

wrong.stem: 选出不同类的一项。
wrong.exp: listen、put、take 都是动作（动词）；card 是名词（卡片），不同类。

wrong.stem: 选出不同类的一项。
wrong.exp: health、habit、card 都是名词；tidy 是形容词，不同类。

wrong.stem: Yang Ling ______ to her teachers carefully in class.
wrong.exp: Yang Ling 是第三人称单数，listen 要加 s：listens。课文：She listens to her teachers carefully.

wrong.stem: Wang Bing ______ notes in class.
wrong.exp: Wang Bing 是第三人称单数，take 加 s：takes notes（记笔记）。

wrong.stem: He ______ his school things in order every evening.
wrong.exp: He 是第三人称单数，put 加 s：puts his school things in order（把他的学习用品整理好）。

wrong.stem: She ______ chores at home every day.
wrong.exp: She 是第三人称单数，do 要变 does：does chores（做家务）。

wrong.stem: ______ a minute! I want to tidy my room first.
wrong.exp: 课文原句：Wait a minute!（等一分钟！）Bobby 就是这样说的。

wrong.stem: Bobby ______ keeps his room tidy.
wrong.exp: 课文原句：Bobby never keeps his room tidy.（Bobby 从不保持房间整齐。）never 是“从不”。

wrong.stem: Reading in bed is bad for your ______.
wrong.exp: 课文：It is bad for her eyes.（在床上读书对眼睛不好。）

wrong.stem: Wang Bing is strong and healthy, but he often goes to bed ______.
wrong.exp: go to bed late 是“晚睡”。课文：he often goes to bed late. 这是他的坏习惯。

wrong.stem: He does exercise every day. He is strong and ______.
wrong.exp: 课文原句：strong and healthy（强壮又健康）。

wrong.stem: She likes reading very much. She reads ______ books.
wrong.exp: 课文原句：She reads a lot of books.（她读很多书。）a lot of 是“很多”。

wrong.stem: What good habits ______ you have?
wrong.exp: 主语是 you，问句要用 do：What good habits do you have? 只有主语是 he/she 时才用 does。

wrong.stem: — ______ is it a bad habit? — Because it is bad for his health.
wrong.exp: 回答用 Because 说的是原因，所以问句要用 Why（为什么）。

wrong.stem: He ______ (keep) his room tidy.
wrong.exp: He 是第三人称单数，keep 加 s：keeps。

wrong.stem: She ______ (listen) to her teachers carefully in class.
wrong.exp: She 是第三人称单数，listen 加 s：listens。

wrong.stem: Wang Bing ______ (put) his school things in order every evening.
wrong.exp: Wang Bing 是第三人称单数，put 加 s：puts。

wrong.stem: He often ______ (go) to bed late.
wrong.exp: go 以字母 o 结尾，第三人称单数加 es：goes。

wrong.stem: She ______ (do) chores at home every day.
wrong.exp: do 的第三人称单数是 does，要整体变，不能只加 s。

wrong.stem: My father ______ (have) many good habits.
wrong.exp: have 的第三人称单数是 has，是特殊变化，要记住。

wrong.stem: Yang Ling ______ (read) a lot of books.
wrong.exp: Yang Ling 是第三人称单数，read 加 s：reads。课文：She reads a lot of books.

wrong.stem: A: What good habits do you have?  B: ______
options: I listen to my teachers carefully.
wrong.right: I listen to my teachers carefully.
wrong.exp: 问“你有什么好习惯”，要用好习惯的内容回答：I listen to my teachers carefully.

wrong.stem: A: Do you have any bad habits?  B: ______
options: Yes. I often read in bed.
wrong.right: Yes. I often read in bed.
wrong.exp: Do 开头的问句先答 Yes，再说出坏习惯：I often read in bed.

wrong.stem: A: ______  B: Because it is bad for my eyes.
options: Why is it a bad habit?
What good habits do you have?
wrong.right: Why is it a bad habit?
wrong.exp: B 用 Because 回答原因，所以 A 要问 Why is it a bad habit?（为什么这是个坏习惯？）

wrong.stem: A: Tina, your room is clean and tidy!  B: Thank you. Bobby, it's your ______ now.
wrong.exp: It's your turn.（轮到你了。）是课本里的句型。

wrong.stem: A: Be careful, Aunt Alice. Bobby ______ keeps his room tidy.  B: OK.
wrong.exp: 课文原句：Bobby never keeps his room tidy. never（从不）放在 keeps 前面。

wrong.stem: 把下面的词连成一句话。
wrong.right: He listens to his teachers carefully .
wrong.exp: 语序：主语 He + listens to his teachers + carefully。主语是 He，listen 用三单 listens。

wrong.stem: 把下面的词连成一句话。
wrong.exp: 课文：She does well at school.（她在学校表现好。）

wrong.stem: 把下面的词连成一句话。
wrong.right: What good habits do you have ?
wrong.exp: 问句语序：What + good habits + do you have? 主语 you 用 do 提问。

wrong.stem: 把下面的词连成一句话。
wrong.right: Bobby never keeps his room tidy .
wrong.exp: never 放在动词 keeps 前面；Bobby 是第三人称单数，keep 变 keeps。

wrong.stem: What does Peter do every day?
wrong.exp: 短文：He does exercise every day.（他每天锻炼。）

wrong.stem: In class, Peter ______.
wrong.exp: 短文：he listens to his teachers carefully and takes notes.（认真听老师讲课，还记笔记。）

wrong.stem: What does Peter do in the evening?
options: He puts his school things in order.
wrong.right: He puts his school things in order.
wrong.exp: 短文：In the evening, he puts his school things in order.（晚上整理学习用品。）

wrong.stem: What is Peter's bad habit?
options: He often goes to bed late.
wrong.exp: 短文：He often reads in bed.（经常在床上读书。）这是 Peter 的坏习惯。

wrong.stem: Reading in bed is bad for Peter's ______.
wrong.exp: 短文：It is bad for his eyes.（对他的眼睛不好。）

wrong.stem: Who is Lucy?
wrong.exp: 短文第一句：Lucy is Yang Ling's friend.

wrong.stem: What does Lucy like very much?
wrong.exp: 短文：She likes reading very much.（她非常喜欢读书。）

wrong.stem: What does Lucy do at home every day?
wrong.exp: 短文：At home, she does chores every day.（在家每天做家务。）

wrong.stem: How is Lucy's room?
options: It is bad for her health.
wrong.exp: 短文：She keeps her room clean and tidy.（她的房间干净整齐。）

wrong.stem: What is Lucy's bad habit?
options: She often goes to bed late.
wrong.right: She often goes to bed late.
wrong.exp: 短文：Lucy often goes to bed late.（经常晚睡。）It is bad for her health.
